blocks.h2: Lowering Your Risk in a Ravenswood Basement
blocks.body: Start outside: keep the gangway drain and window wells clear and send downspouts away from the walls. Then check the plumbing. A clear lateral drains better in a storm. A sump pump with a battery backup handles groundwater. If sewer water has come up the floor drain before, a backflow valve or overhead sewer is the protection that actually keeps it out. In a building with a garden unit, that last step matters most.

blocks.h2: Basement Flooding Questions From Ravenswood Homeowners

items.q: Is it sewer water or groundwater?
items.answer: Through the floor drain is usually sewer water. At the walls is groundwater.

items.q: We flooded in 2011. Could it happen again?
items.answer: Yes. Big storms will keep coming. Protection is what changes the outcome.

items.q: Do you remove water and dry the basement?
items.preview: We fix the cause. A restoration company dries it.
items.answer: We fix the plumbing cause. A restoration company handles drying.

items.q: What's the best protection for a garden unit?
items.preview: An overhead sewer for repeat backups.
items.answer: For repeat sewer backups, an overhead sewer. For groundwater, a sump pump with a backup.

items.q: Do older basements need different protection?
items.preview: The same tools, planned around old walls.
items.answer: The same tools work. We just plan the installation around old foundations.

items.q: How much does basement flooding repair cost in Ravenswood?
items.preview: It depends on the cause. You'll approve a flat price first.
items.answer: It depends on the cause and what's needed. You'll approve a flat-rate price before we start.
